# Perth Wheelchair Taxi Van & Maxi Cab Service

> Factual business summary and transport specifications for Perth Wheelchair Taxi Van.

## Business Profile
- Business Name: Perth Wheelchair Taxi Van
- Location: Based in Girrawheen, Western Australia 6064
- Service Area: Perth Metropolitan Area, approximately 20 km radius around Girrawheen, including Perth CBD, Perth Airport (Terminals T1, T2, T3, T4), Joondalup, Fremantle, Scarborough, Nedlands, and Swan Valley.
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (24/7), by phone and advance reservation.
- Phone / Voice: +61 493 252 766

## Vehicle & Accessibility Specifications
- Vehicle Types: Long-wheelbase maxi taxi vans equipped with rear foldout ramps or hydraulic lifts [TODO: confirm exact vehicle make/model with owner].
- Passenger Capacity: Up to 10 standard seated passengers, or wheelchair occupants plus carers and companions (seated configurations vary by wheelchair footprint).
- Wheelchair Compatibility: Manual wheelchairs, motorized / electric powerchairs, and mobility scooters fitting standard Australian commercial passenger vehicle door clearances (1,500 mm+ vertical entry height [TODO: confirm exact dimensions with owner]).
- Safety Restraints: 4-point floor tie-down anchor system with heavy-duty lap/sash occupant seatbelt. Passengers travel safely secured in their wheelchairs.
- Child Restraints: Rear-facing baby capsules, forward-facing child safety seats, and booster seats available on advance booking request.

## Subsidies, NDIS & Payment Methods
- WA Passenger Transport Subsidy Scheme (PTSS, formerly TUSS): Effective 1 October 2025, paper TUSS vouchers can no longer be used in taxis per the WA Department of Transport; participants use a PTSS card. Standard subsidy: 50% of the fare up to $25 cap. Wheelchair subsidy in a wheelchair-accessible taxi: 75% up to $35 cap. [TODO: owner to confirm licence/registration for PTSS card processing terminal].
- National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS): Itemized tax invoices containing vehicle registration, pickup, drop-off, date, and ABN provided for self-managed and plan-managed participants under Core Support - Transport (Category 02). [TODO: owner to confirm NDIS provider registration / invoicing setup].
- Payment Types: EFTPOS, Visa, Mastercard, cash, and electronic PTSS card (subject to terminal confirmation). Upfront fixed quotes available on request.
